Chilling winds and damp air brush against the Sinner under the umbrella.

"Ah!"
[{0}] stood before the gentleman's mountainous belly.

Completely still, not moving a muscle.

"... Been a while, since we've done something like this together."
“……离上次做这种事过去很久了。”
"Yes. Remember? Starbuck, on helm. You, me, shouting at Starbuck..."
“很经常。斯达巴克，掌舵。你和我，很大声。”
"Yeah..."
But the horde of Mermaids attacking our ship doesn't seem any smaller than it did when we first entered.
但人鱼依旧不断涌出，看不到水路的尽头。
There aren't any more useful boxes around... We decided to move on to the next area.
似乎没有其他有调查价值的箱子了，于是我们向下一个空间移动。
Who will step forth?
应该让谁上前？
We pick up the coin, but...
虽然得到了铜钱……
{0} doesn't seem very happy about it.
但进行惩罚的罪人{0}表情似乎不太好。
The teal-colored fairy appeared again at the tip of the branch.
坐在树枝上的青绿色精灵再次现身了。
Attacking that fairy again will reveal its true form.
再次攻击那只精灵，或许就能让它显露真容。
This isn’t your first time facing this entity. It won’t be as hard as the first time.
既然是已经见过的敌人，与之战斗不会再像第一次一样折磨了吧。
The Sinners seem to agree.
罪人们貌似也是这么想的。
Who will answer the bait?
让哪位罪人回应那诱饵？
After a light leap into the air, the Sinner swung the weapon toward the fairy.
一跃而起的罪人对着精灵迎头痛击。
The fairy appeared to scream, but no sound came from its mouth.
精灵像是在喊着什么，但那并没有引起空气的振动，也无法汇聚成声音加以传达。
Maybe it wasn’t screaming at all. Perhaps it was just the swaying of branches.
因此，或许这份摇曳并非精灵的垂死挣扎，而仅仅是树枝的颤动。
”The eyes are coming out…”
“眼睛都跳出来了……”
”Get outta there! Here we go again.”
“快从那儿出来！又要开始了。”
Numerous eyes open one by one, gleaming from the shadows.
地板上漆黑的阴影中，无数的眼睛接连睁开。
They oscillate as though they’ll jump out at us at any minute.
它们正以即将袭击而来的气势颤动着。
So… What now?
那么，接下来该如何是好？
After lightly leaping into the air, the Sinner swung the weapon toward the fairy.
一跃而起的罪人对着精灵迎头痛击。
But…
但是……
”That thing can dodge…?!”
“那东西……是会躲的？”
Of course, it wasn’t going to be that easy. Assuming that a bait would remain stationary is a complacent thought.
大概是以为诱饵不会乱动，所以太过疏忽了吧？
The fairy had also lightly flown up into the air and glared at the Sinner, who dared to attack it.
罪人跳起多高，那精灵便飞离枝头多远，而后瞪着袭击自己的罪人。
”G-get out of there! It’s starting to move again!”
“总、总之先出来！又要开始了！”
[{0}] tried to get away, but its main body had already tightened around the Sinner's legs.
虽然罪人[{0}]尽力脱离了那里，但逐渐显露出的本体缠住了罪人的脚。
So… What now?
那么……接下来该如何是好？
{0} approached the gnomes who were busily packing away at the gifts.
罪人[{0}]向正在制作礼物的小矮人们走去。
They stared at {0} with blank expressions for a moment, before raising their tools sky-high in unison.
小矮人们茫然地看了罪人[{0}]一眼，随后兴奋地高高举起工具。
'Human-ome!!'
“是人类诺姆！！”
'We were runnin' pretty low on human supply-ome! How timely-ome!!'
“我们正巧缺人诺姆！！”
'Let's take 'em-ome!'

"Hm? You like that model? Ooh, new girl's got an eye for quality! Excuse me~! Can we try this model? Oh, c'mon, relax! I know the deal—'You break it, you buy it.' Thanks! Hehe... See? Told ya I'm a regular here~ Okay, so the sword and the scabbard come as a set, so grab 'em both and feel the weight. How's that? Not as heavy as they look, huh?"
“什么？你喜欢那个型号吗？我们小老末的眼光很不错嘛？店长~这个型号可以试一下吗？欸~当然啦！弄坏的话我们会付钱的，不必担心！嘿嘿。我不是说过了嘛？因为是常客所以这种事完全没问题啦~剑和剑鞘是一套的，一并拿起来吧。怎么样，比看上去要轻不少吧？”

"So there's this particle? Powder? Thingy in that scabbard under patent by Mook Workshop! Every time you sheathe and unsheathe the sword, for a brief moment, its blade comes out way sharper and lighter! And that model you're holding happens to focus on the sharpness! So it's like, *Ding!* and voila, you get a nice buff on your weapon!"
“墨工坊持有专利的那个粒子？还是粉末来着？反正是那一类的东西，被放进了这个剑鞘里。所以每次收回后再拔出时，剑刃都会变得特别锋利，剑也会在瞬间变得很轻。其中把重点放在提高锋锐度上的型号，就是现在小老末手里拿着的这一把咯。总之，每次拔剑出鞘的时候，都有一种叮~一声加上了BUFF的感觉！”

"I think it's one of the Ye [銳] series models—that's Mook Workshop's classic lineup, by the way. Check out the finish here, it's... What the heck?! Hey, this is the Ye [銳] 'Type II' model that went out of production! You know what, this stuff really isn't easy to come by—we're lucky we found one here!"
“这把应该是墨工坊经典型号之一，锐系列中的一款！从这个后处理来看的话……什么？！这不是已经停产的锐 二式吗？！这可是很难弄到手的东西，没想到这里居然还有一把？！”
"If it's such a rarity, Lady Ezra, perhaps you ought to wield it instead..."
“是那么贵重的物品吗？那么，不如就由小姐您来使用它……”

"Hnngh... No, it's fine... Well, I can see it's literally made for you! And it'll work real nice with those boosters on your new prosthetic arms. It'll need some getting used to, but you'll be one heck of a fighter once you get the hang of it! Anyway, consider it a gift from yours truly—you're officially one of us now. Officially our new girl! No more temp ID."
“唔唔唔……不用！不管怎么看都是为小老末你设计的东西！和义手的推进功能也很适配。用顺手可能要花上一点时间，不过如果能用好的话，以后到哪儿都不会比别人逊色的哟？总之，就当作是庆祝从临时成员正式成为小老末的纪念，前辈买给你的！”
"Then... I shall accept with gratitude."
“那么……我便满怀感激地收下了。”

"By the way... Remember that 'classic lineup' part? It's super durable, but there are delicate parts that you should watch out not to break—okay, you know what, let 'em break if it really comes to that. Just..."
“啊。不愧是经典款，结实是真够结实的，不过还是有些精细的部分，小心别把它弄坏了……不，弄坏了倒也没关系。只是……”
"Just don't die on us."
“别死了。”
"... I shall take your words to heart."
“……这句话，我会深深铭记在心。”
